notes:
Account snapshot: Embercliff builds SmartDocs (search + summarization for mid-market legal + sales teams). Initially adopted Redwood Hosted API for rapid proof-of-value (Q1 trial); now evaluating Dedicated for cost predictability, VPC isolation, and SSO/KMS controls.

POC goals & success metrics:
- Validate latency & cost delta vs Hosted (target: p95 < 450ms for chat endpoints; token cost reduction >= 30%).
- Confirm reliability under steady-state throughput (500 reqs/min baseline; 1k burst).
- Demonstrate canary rollout and safe rollback: automated policy triggers based on error_rate and latency regressions.
- Verify private control plane + KMS flows, SSO (SAML) end-to-end.
- Exportable logs + audit entries for compliance review.

Technical POC plan (agreed):
- Environment: Staging Dedicated cluster in us-east (VPC peered to Embercliff dev VPC).
- Canary: 10% of traffic for 48 hours, then 30% for 24 hours if metrics stable.
- Canary checks: p95 latency (compare to baseline), anomaly in top-5 prompt failure/error types, token cost per 1k tokens. Automated rollback if error_rate > 1% OR p95 > 2x baseline OR produced hallucination rate on eval prompts > 5%.
- Model variants: primary run on quantized high-perf variant (e.g., 13B-q4/optimized), fallback to smaller 7B quantized variant on degradation. A/B evaluation against Hosted baseline model for quality delta.
- Routing & fallback: smart routing policy to prefer low-latency region (us-east) with automatic region failover to eu-west for synthetic traffic when region outage simulated; fallback mapping preconfigured: primary -> quantized-13b, fallback -> quantized-7b, emergency -> hosted-api-readonly (if Dedicated cluster unreachable).
- Observability: enable token-level cost breakdown, per-route p95/p99, tracing hooks, and eval-set scoring pipeline for nightly quality checks.

Security & compliance notes:
- Embercliff requires SAML SSO for staff + KMS for key material; cannot allow token export outside VPC for PII flows. Retention policy: 90 days logs, 7 days prompt cache by default (customer requested options).
- Infosec asked for encryption-at-rest proof + HSM/KMS integration examples; Diego to provide integration runbook.

Commercial notes:
- Prefers annual reserved capacity if Dedicated POC hits targets. Initial ARR expectation $75k-$200k depending on burst licenses and reserved commit. Finance wants a 60-day cost reconciliation window before committing.
